messages:
Sam Nguyen: Hey team — CI on my branch flipped red right after I regenerated the poetry lockfile (I ran `poetry lock --no-update` to pick up a transitive fix). Install is failing with a content-hash mismatch for a wheel. Anyone seen this from a lock regen?
Maya Patel: link to the failing CI? can you paste the exact error lines?
Sam Nguyen: https://ci.redwood/example/12345 — here's the relevant excerpt:
```text
ERROR: THESE PACKAGES DO NOT MATCH THE HASHES FROM THE REQUIREMENTS FILE.
    brotli 1.0.9 from https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/.../brotli-1.0.9-cp38-cp38-manylinux.whl#sha256=abcd...
    Expected sha256: 0123456789abcdef...
    Actual sha256:   fedcba9876543210...
```
Sam Nguyen: I didn't change direct deps, only the lockfile regen and pushed the lockfile commit `c3f5a8d`.
Ryan Chen: That usually means the wheel on PyPI was rebuilt or mirrors differ. It can break reproducible installs when you commit hashes. Two immediate options: revert the lockfile change to unblock CI, or update the lock hashes to match upstream.
Ryan Chen: Quick repro check: run locally `pip download brotli==1.0.9 --no-deps -d /tmp/wheels` and then `sha256sum /tmp/wheels/brotli-1.0.9-*.whl` to compare. If the hash differs from the lockfile, the wheel was changed upstream.
Ava Park: @Sam can you try a CI rerun with cache cleared? sometimes our pip cache/mirror mismatch causes transient diffs. If still failing, revert and we'll bisect.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by @Ava Park — pipeline queued (build/12345).
Maya Patel: If this is a rebuild on PyPI, we should avoid re-locking without understanding why the hash changed (security/typo in build). If you need to unblock, revert the lockfile commit and open a follow-up to investigate the upstream artifact.
Sam Nguyen: Ok I'll rerun with cache clear and then revert if it still fails. If anyone wants to bisect, the problematic range is parent `b7a11c2`..`c3f5a8d` (the lockfile change is the latter).
Ryan Chen: I can take the bisect after lunch. If it's a PyPI rebuild we'll either update the lock with a note or pin to a different version. Also file an issue to check our index/mirror settings.
Sam Nguyen: thanks — reverting lockfile as a quick unblock now. Will leave a note in the PR describing follow-up triage steps. :thumbsup:
